t_01a19f0a4cc8b092.title: Fix main CI: test_termux_assembly_permissions FileExistsError on reused HERMES_TEST_DOCKER_MOUNT_ROOT payload dir
t_01a19f0a4cc8b092.body:
Main CI run https://github.com/daveey/hermes/actions/runs/41556904515 (head c34694e325d), job "Python tests / Termux assembly permissions" (125665322801) failed:

```
FAILED tests/scripts/test_termux_assembly_permissions.py::test_assembly_publishes_facts_as_termux_uid_and_returns_host_owned_output[success] - FileExistsError: [Errno 17] File exists: '/opt/actions-runner/_work/_temp/termux-assembly/test_assembly_publishes_facts_0/payload'
(same for [failed-build], ..._1/payload)
```

Cause (from the code at tests/scripts/test_termux_assembly_permissions.py:51): with `HERMES_TEST_DOCKER_MOUNT_ROOT` set, the payload dir is `mount_root / tmp_path.name / "payload"`. `tmp_path.name` (`test_assembly_publishes_facts_0`) is only unique within one pytest basetemp, but the mount root is a runner-temp dir shared across runs on the long-lived docker-ci runner, so a leftover from a previous run collides and `mkdir(parents=True)` raises.

Fix: make the per-test dir unique and owned by the test (e.g. `tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=mount_root)` or include a uuid/pid), and clean it up in a finalizer (contents may be owned by the container uid: use the same container to chown/rm, or rm with tolerant handling). Do not just add exist_ok=True (stale content from another run would leak into the assertions).

Done when: the PR is merged to main and the Termux assembly permissions job is green on main's next CI run. Prior related deflake cards: t_01a1899a15eff3c8, t_01a187714d4b30a9 (done).

t_62ce7dc1.title: daveey/hermes: flaky tests/gateway/test_session_api.py::test_interim_commentary_reaches_session_sse_and_responses_stream on hub runners
t_62ce7dc1.body:
Found while getting main CI green (t_7131b872, PR https://github.com/daveey/hermes/pull/32).

The test fails intermittently on the self-hosted hermes-hub runners:
- FAILED on main push run https://github.com/daveey/hermes/actions/runs/39886244584 (job 120195193519, "Python tests / Run tests (1/2)"): `assert [] == [('Checking the docs first.', False)]` at tests/gateway/test_session_api.py:1377. The session SSE stream had no `assistant.commentary` event; `assistant.completed` was present.
- PASSED in PR #30 run 39886091334 on the same code (except #30's one-line workflow change).

What we know: `_commentary` (gateway/platforms/api_server.py ~3657) calls `events.enqueue`, and `_SessionEventQueue.enqueue` hops to the loop with `call_soon_threadsafe` when it runs off-loop. The fake agent calls `interim(...)` inside `run_conversation`. Find out why the event goes missing under load. It might be an ordering race between the enqueue hop and `run_agent`'s completion, something leaking from an earlier test in the file (gateway config / display.interim_assistant_messages cache), or an executor/loop mismatch. If it's a real product race, so commentary can be lost or reordered after `assistant.completed`, fix the product code, not the test.

Repro: run the file on hermes-hub (`ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o IdentitiesOnly=yes ubuntu@100.104.201.88`), under load and in a loop, with scripts/run_tests.sh. Fork commits are tagged `[daveey]`. Merge once the PR's CI is green. Done when there's a root cause, a fix merged, and 20+ loop runs green.

t_01a18e0f85fa5317.body:

Context: transcript links `a.q__src` carry an aria-label built in English by `scripts/build_site.py` `cite()` ("<speaker> in <episode> at <m:ss>: open the transcript there") and translated at render by the `site_i18n` rewriter via the pattern added in #137 (5d105c5a). The regression test `tests/test_untranslated_english.py::test_under_the_hood_screen_reader_labels_are_translated` checks all 7 non-en LANGS but only `eve/under-the-hood/`. Do: extend (parametrize) the test to cover `eve/`, `eve/changed-mind/` and `eve/under-the-hood/` for de, es, fr, pt, ru, zh, fa; assert each page has >=1 q__src label, no label matches the English template (` in .+ at \d`, "open the transcript there"), and the timestamp survives. t_01a18505110a5892.title: Fix load-fragile 2s wait in session-resume cancel test
t_01a18505110a5892.body:
GOAL
Fix the single-test failure that made daveey/hermes CI run 40785006949 conclude failure, so a busy CI host cannot turn this test's deadlock guard into a red required check.

EVIDENCE
- Run https://github.com/daveey/hermes/actions/runs/40785006949 event=push head=a0ebd73b9c91b6a69f133898179c059ba592b4ee conclusion=failure (completed 2026-10-29T00:16Z).
- Failed job: Python tests / Run tests (2/2), job 123156990828, runner ec2-gwgen-1, started 2026-10-28T23:31:07Z, test step failed.
- Check-run annotation (the only failure): tests/tui_gateway/test_tui_gateway_server.py::test_session_resume_deferred_history_close_cancels_build KeyError '68b90e2c' at line 3823. Same annotation: 1 failed, 670 passed in 264.34s. Inner cause printed in captured stdout: `assert release_history.wait(timeout=2.0)` failed, then the resume error path emitted "Could not reopen that session (its transcript could not be read)" and removed the session before the test reached `server._sessions[sid]`.
- Gate job 123181572825 failed only because "1 job(s) failed: tests".
- Test source is unchanged from that head through origin/main 7adaa5306ee98531eafe21d4f15bddbf86969b1a (function at line 3783). No open card already owns this test.
- At 00:12Z on ec2-gwgen-1, the host was running this shard plus dispatch run 40785530488 and e2e path tests: four node web.mjs builds at ~84% CPU and many pytest workers. The test's 2.0s waiter (line 3800) is the deadlock guard; the test only sets release_history after it closes the session (line 3830), which it never reached.

FIVE WHYS
Problem: shard 2 of push 40785006949 failed one test and the required gate, so the containing run could not be acceptance.
Why 1: the test looked up _sessions[sid] after that session was already gone — evidence: KeyError at line 3823, sid 68b90e2c.
Why 2: the deferred history loader's 2.0s wait expired and the error path tore the session down — evidence: annotation quotes `wait(timeout=2.0)` matching line 3800.
Why 3: the test thread did not close the session within 2s of the waiter starting — evidence: close is after resume() returns (lines 3826-3830); KeyError at 3823 means the session was gone before that close.
Why 4: the runner was CPU-saturated by concurrent jobs — evidence: ps on ec2-gwgen-1 at 00:12Z (four node builds ~84% plus other pytest workers).
Root (happened): the test uses a 2s wall-clock assert as its synchronization point. CI host contention exceeds that budget and the guard becomes a false failure.
Root (not caught): one timing failure fails the whole required Python shard; nothing retries or widens the guard under load.
Recurrence: first observed here. Do not bump the timeout blindly without a regression that fails when the waiter is not released, and passes when it is released after a delay longer than 2s.

ACCEPTANCE
- The deadlock guard no longer fails the test when the test thread is delayed past 2s but still closes the session.
- A regression test or the existing test, run for real, fails if release_history is never set, and passes when it is set after a delay.
- Do not cancel in-flight daveey/hermes main push runs to free a runner. This card is NOT a parent of t_01a184543d488b8d; a later fully green containing push still closes that card.

End the turn after continue.

Then: sudo systemctl stop ci-superseded-sweeper.timer, let the timing report finish, confirm conclusion, sudo systemctl start ci-superseded-sweeper.timer. Record the pause. A sweeper cancel is not a concurrency-fix failure; do not file that card. If you lose the race and it is cancelled after all real jobs succeeded, follow the next in-flight containing push.
4. If a different test fails, record the job and annotation. Fix only if trivial and attributable; otherwise file a card and name it in your completion. Same 2s KeyError: comment on t_01a18505110a5892 only.
5. Verify before success: git merge-base --is-ancestor 250ee8a8a8e1d3688b0e4f4cd255f0e0f74ca9bf <head>; that head is an ancestor of freshly fetched origin/main; shared checkout status and diff clean; wt-ci-dispatch absent; remove any worktree you created.
6. Comment the green run URL, event, head SHA, conclusion, ancestry, and actions on t_01a1815d5433bfac and on t_01a184543d488b8d. Then complete THIS card with that evidence in summary and metadata. If no green run is achievable, complete THIS card with the concrete blocker and the follow-up card id. Never report success without a fully green containing run.
